about: #2868: the answers core-backend gives for an alias id, shaped by the wire contract (GET /api/v1/public/cves/{id}: resolved_from, aliases, eu_kev; the list: a top-level resolved_from) and core-backend's own tests (internal/cve/vuln_ids_db_test.go, vuln_ids_attribution_db_test.go: every value of source enisa_euvd carries an attribution beginning "Source: ENISA EUVD", the founder's decision of 2026-10-11). NOT a production capture: production serves none of these fields until core-backend ships them. The EUVD id and its CVE are ENISA's positive control (EUVD-2026-90503 -> CVE-2026-80276, read from /api/enisaid on 2026-10-12); the EU KEV listing's values are illustrative of the shape (date, CSIRT) and are not a claim about that CVE. Replace each body with a capture through the hosted endpoint once production serves the fields.
